ref.quote: Ce programme regroupe l’ensemble des dépenses relatives à l’Organisme Payeur de Wallonie pour assurer la mise en œuvre et le paiement des mesures d’aides aux exploitations agricoles, coopératives ou associations dans le cadre de la Politique Agricole Commune (PAC) | Entretien des cours d'eau non navigables et des ouvrages de régularisation du régime des eaux de première catégorie | Subventions de fonctionnement aux parcs naturels | gestion des sites Natura 2000
ref.note: Most CAP payments to farmers are EU-funded and do not pass through this line; the Region pays its co-financing share and the paying agency's (OPW) running costs, so the farm-support phrase refers to the regional share only. Streams here are the non-navigable watercourses managed by the Region (navigable waterways are in the mobility line); the flood link is stated in the introduction (PDF p. 3: 'la gestion des cours d'eau non navigables et [...] la prévention des inondations constitue une priorité majeure') and in the legal basis of DF 061.007 (PDF p. 52). Waste prevention and sorting (programme 15.064, wal-aju-2026-ep-sante PDF p. 45, and the waste fund 15.077) is also in this line but no longer has its own phrase. Large items not described in the phrases: the Walloon 'Kyoto' climate fund (programme 15.074, financed by emission-allowance revenue; its uses are not detailed in the annexes read), the environment protection fund (15.075), air/water/soil protection (15.062), SPW ARNE studies and monitoring (15.057), animal welfare (15.059) and the agricultural calamities fund. corrected: quotes and pages confirmed in bud39 (parcs naturels and Natura 2000 rows are on p. 43). Point 7: dropped the fourth phrase (waste prevention and sorting), the weakest since it rests on a second document and a smaller programme; noted in the caveat. Nature phrase shortened in FR. Flood-prevention wording kept: the annex states it explicitly. The streams FR phrase stays at ten words; shortening it would drop either the streams or the flood part.
